<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/v3/error/integration/{integrationId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Searches errors for the specified integration within the current subscription. Results are newest first.
When from and to are omitted, all retained persisted errors are included. An empty errors collection returns 200, not 404.
An empty result does not distinguish an integration with no errors from an integration that does not exist.
Use skip, size, and hasNextPage to iterate through results.
